title: Incident responder proposal
description: What the headless agent must return (claude -p --json-schema). It is a proposal: policy.py decides what, if anything, is executed.

is_real_incident.description: False for test alerts or alerts the evidence does not support.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a person paged at night can act on.

user_impact.description: Who could not do what, where, since when, how many failed requests.

suspected_cause.description: The root cause as far as the evidence shows, naming file and function when the stack trace allows.

image.description: The image the evidence implicates, or an empty string.

commit.description: Git commit of that image, or an empty string.

file.description: Evidence file (or repo path) the finding comes from.

follow_up.description: What a human should do next (fix, test to add), never executed.
